text: Berkshire Hathaway repurchased $9.6 billion in shares in Q3, versus $4.5 billion in Q2. Operating earnings fell 5.8% to $12.705 billion; net earnings declined 28% to $22.112 billion. Insurance underwriting profits dropped 43%. Total cash holdings rose 3% to $377.435 billion.

meta.note: Total cash increased, while adjusted cash excluding rail, utility, and T-bill items declined 1.9% QoQ.
